CustomField.description: Current calendar-day age since creation, grouped for operational reports. Continues aging after completion; the open report excludes completed instances.
CustomField.formula: IF(TODAY() - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) <= 7, "1: 0-7 days", IF(TODAY() - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) <= 30, "2: 8-30 days", "3: 31+ days"))
CustomField.label: Age Band
